title: HDR10 PGS subtitle palette (PQ, BT.2020) uploaded unconverted to an SDR (sRGB, BT.709) GUI
expected_finding: the PGS palette entries are PQ-encoded BT.2020 values (converted with the HDR10 video's colour space), and the host expands them unchanged into pgs_overlay_texture, which fsMain writes into the SDR B8G8R8A8_UNORM GUI surface that expects sRGB-encoded BT.709: no PQ decode, white-point scaling, BT.2020 -> BT.709 conversion or sRGB encode (dull, hue-shifted subtitles)
